Greystone Managed Investments Inc sold 1,863 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 116,080 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $19.64 million, down from 117,943 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Greystone Managed Investments Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $931.57B market cap company. The stock increased 0.73% or $1.38 during the last trading session, reaching $189.53. About 10.09 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 25, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Etrade Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Schlumberger Ltd (SLB) by 9.01% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Schlumberger Limited (NYSE:SLB) has declined 16.28% since May 25, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.83% the S&P500.
Etrade Capital Management Llc, which manages about $2.37 billion and $3.12 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Spdr Doubleline Total Return by 8,712 shares to 19,921 shares, valued at $969,000 in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Boeing Co/The (NYSE:BA) by 1,946 shares in the quarter, for a total of 10,174 shares, and has risen its stake in International Paper Co (NYSE:IP).
Analysts await Schlumberger Limited (NYSE:SLB) to report earnings on July, 20. They expect $0.46 EPS, up 31.43% or $0.11 from last year’s $0.35 per share. SLB’s profit will be $637.13M for 37.17 P/E if the $0.46 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.38 actual EPS reported by Schlumberger Limited for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 21.05% EPS growth.
